text: 上证指数午盘涨0.95%，创业板指涨0.96%。房地产、军工、汽车、农林牧渔、有色金属板块领涨。AI硬件侧核心标的逐渐复苏，长鑫科技、工业富联、中际旭创走升。银行、海运板块休整，覆铜板板块低迷。 全市场ETF行情总览（已剔除重复跟踪标的） 涨幅前五的ETF：通用航空ETF永赢涨6.41%，通用航空ETF南方涨5.95%，房地产ETF银华涨5.43%，航空航天ETF华夏涨5.34%，航空航天ETF华泰柏瑞涨5.06%。 跌幅前五的ETF：巴西ETF易方达跌3.01%，标普油气ETF富国跌1.27%，新兴亚洲ETF招商跌0.55%，线上消费ETF工银跌0.5
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.95% at midday, and the ChiNext Index rose 0.96%. Real estate, defense, autos, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery, and nonferrous metals sectors led gains. Core AI hardware names gradually recovered, with Changxin Technology, Foxconn Industrial Internet, and Zhongji Innolight advancing. Banks and shipping sectors took a breather, while the copper-clad laminate sector was sluggish. Overview of the overall ETF market (duplicate tracking targets excluded) Top five gainers: General Aviation ETF Yongying rose 6.41%, General Aviation ETF Nanfang rose 5.95%, Real Estate ETF Yinhua rose 5.43%, Aerospace ETF Huaxia rose 5.34%, Aerospace ETF Huatai-PineBridge rose 5.06%. Top five decliners: Brazil ETF E Fund fell 3.01%, S&P Oil & Gas ETF Fullgoal fell 1.27%, Emerging Asia ETF China Merchants fell 0.55%, Online Consumption ETF ICBC fell 0.5
